'''Hennet Kayn''' was a [[Gotal]] who spent [[time]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]], Kayn was in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]] confronted the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] in one of the [[Cantina|establishment's]] booths. Kayn moved into one of the other booths just before Solo shot and [[Death|killed]] Greedo.

==Biography==
The [[Gotal]] Hennet Kayn<ref name="SWCC">{{SW|url=news/swcc-2019-6-surprises-from-inside-the-mos-eisley-cantina|text=SWCC 2019: 6 Surprises from Inside the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> was present in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[desert]] [[planet]]<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1|Hennet Kayn's [[time]] in [[Mos Eisley]]}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Gotal was in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in Mos Eisley when the [[human]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] attempted to leave the establishment, only to be forced back into his seat by the [[Rodian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]].<ref name="ANH" />

As Solo and Greedo discussed the [[bounty]] that [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had placed on the smuggler's head, Kayn walked from the direction of the [[cantina]]'s main bar into a booth,<ref name="ANH" /> where the [[Abyssin]] [[Myo]] and the [[Talz]]<ref name="Complete locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[thief]]<ref name="FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=The Kloo Horn Cantina Caper|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}}</ref> [[Muftak]] were seated.<ref name="Complete locations" /> Solo and Greedo then exchanged [[blaster]]fire, with Solo [[Death|killing]] the bounty hunter, which briefly drew the attention of many patrons in the cantina.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Kayn had [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[Hair|fur]] and skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While at the Mos Eisley Cantina, Kayn wore a dark-brown [[Clothing|shirt]] over light-brown [[robe]]s and brown shoes.<ref name="Cantina BTS">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HennetKaynBTS.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Jibralta Merrill stands in costume as Hennet Kayn with various lighting an production material visible in the background.|Hennet Kayn used components from the costumes of several other cantina characters.]]
Hennet Kayn first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> [[Jibralta Merrill]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref> The character's costume was made up of items from the costumes of several other Mos Eisley Cantina patrons, including [[Trinto Duaba]]'s robe, [[M'iiyoom Onith]]'s shirt, and a mask and claws used by fellow Gotals [[Feltipern Trevagg]] and [[Cobb Sonbepol]].<ref name="Cantina Math">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog}} shows what costume components were used for the Hennet Kayn costume. [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] identifies each of the characters whose costumes were used.</ref> The mask was designed by conceptual artist [[Ron Cobb]]<ref name="Chronicle">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and created by makeup artist [[Laine Liska]].<ref name="Rolecall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

Costume designer [[Rick Baker]] had originally created the claws as props for the [[1974]] horror film [[Wikipedia:It's Alive (1974 film)|''It's Alive'']].<ref name="Claws">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog}} shows that the claws used in the Hennet Kayn costume were originally from a set of props all made by [[Rick Baker]] for the film [[Wikipedia:It's Alive (1974 film)|''It's Alive'']], identifiable by the distinctive monster baby prop as seen in the following image: {{IMDb|url=title/tt0071675/mediaviewer/rm2118398464|text=Rick Baker in It's Alive (1974)|archivedate=20190522205651}}</ref> Liska modified the claws with fur for ''[[Star Wars]]''.<ref name="Cantina BTS" /> The cantina character Myo also used a separate pair of the same claw props but without the fur.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The Hennet Kayn character name was first created at the "[[Behind the Scenes of the Cantina]]" panel at [[Celebration Chicago|''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago]] in [[2019]].
After panel host [[Tom Spina]] discovered production images of Kayn, he and [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] named the character [[Tuckerization|based on]] panel attendee [[Kenneth Haynie]], who won the honor during the panel.<ref name="SWCC" />
